first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMBs, and inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing previously produced strong acquisition and revenue lift in that segment. Verify the pricing result and the onboarding alternative before committing; keep the offer targeted and measure qualified conversion, retention, and post-promotion value to protect sustainable revenue.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. It directly addresses the 4% decline in completion and is supported by verified evidence of higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), while prior evidence also supports signup simplification for SMB activation. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than discounting, whose verified acquisition lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline. Measure meaningful activation, qualified conversion, and cohort retention alongside completion.
